title: Prompt OS / Context Foundry / Working Set current-successor archaeology

scope.non_overlap_rule: Do not reproduce or write the historical adoption ledger owned by the priority-210 recovery lane. This return maps only current functional successors, runtime participation and direct reuse boundaries.

evidence.finding: Defines guide-grade shared cognitive kernel, bounded Working Set, exact context receipt, L0 plus role/task-specific L1/L2 sources, CONTEXT_COMPILE role, and explicit obligation to search/reuse Prompt OS / Context Foundry / Working Sets before inventing duplicates.

Builds per-workstream compiled-work-packet/v3 artifacts. The emitted packet explicitly calls itself compiled working context, carries authority, intent, decisions, targets, failures, scope, dependencies, state, relevant deltas/events, conditional read graph and refresh contract.

Current runtime publishes the workstream-level compiled context and relevant coordination state. Exact inspection found no context_receipt field in this packet; it is not evidence of a per-task/per-worker bounded Working Set materialization.

Implements current context-receipt validation: required L0 refs, guide-grade strategic refs across L0/L1/L2, authority labels, source freshness, contradiction ledger warning and bounded context budget warning. Also recognizes CONTEXT_COMPILE as a first-class role.

Can choose CONTEXT_COMPILE when context_compile_required and context_compile_authorized, returning COMPILE_CONTEXT/SCOPED_LOCAL_RECEIPT. It selects the role but does not itself materialize a Working Set.
Kernel implementation is already exclusively owned by O-SWARM-KERNEL-IMPLEMENT-V1; no duplicate kernel/context validator should be created here.
Kernel lane is under recovery with existing partial targets detected and mission to preserve/validate/complete those bytes before durable RETURN.
Allocator implementation is already exclusively owned by O-SWARM-ROLE-FLUID-ALLOCATOR-V1; no duplicate allocator should be created here.
Priority-210 archaeology explicitly owns historical reconciliation of Prompt OS, Context Foundry, Working Set and adjacent mechanisms.
A recovery attempt started at 09:19 and owns the reopenable historical adoption ledger. Exact historical ACTIVE/MERGED/SUPERSEDED/RETIRED classification remains delegated there.

findings.statement: Do not resurrect Context Foundry as a second global compiler. Its current functional successor is the Agent Runtime compiler path that already emits compiled working context. Reuse/extend that owner when a compiler change is actually required.

Working Set semantics are binding in Universal Cognitive Worker v1: bounded context is allowed for narrow workers, L0 laws remain mandatory, and substantive runs must persist an exact context receipt. The candidate kernel makes those receipt requirements machine-checkable.

Current evidence proves workstream-level compiled packets, role selection for CONTEXT_COMPILE, and receipt validation. It does not prove an executable path that takes a selected opportunity/role and materializes the bounded per-task Working Set/receipt automatically. Absence is limited to inspected current runtime/queue/candidate paths; historical recovery may surface a reusable mechanism.

Current Prompt-OS-like responsibilities are distributed across the canonical /wc bootstrap, Universal Cognitive Worker wake/kernel contract and role-fluid allocator. Exact historical lineage/classification is not asserted here because the priority-210 recovery lane owns that evidence.

Agent Runtime packet v3 is a reusable compiled workstream context and refresh mechanism; treating it as if it were already the worker's exact context receipt would collapse two distinct evidence levels and overstate runtime integration.
